description: Site tĩnh gồm các nhóm tool: Base64, JSON, HTML, mã hoá (tạo key, mã hoá/giải mã, hash...). Deploy GitHub Pages, custom domain tools.anhlp.com (DNS trên Cloudflare, zone anhlp.com).

closed.summary: https://tools.anhlp.com live: 27 client-side tools (Base64, JSON, HTML, Crypto, Misc), Notion-style UI, GitHub Pages via Actions (repo phucanh08/tools) with headless-Chrome gate in CI, Cloudflare CNAME DNS-only, HTTPS cert approved + enforced. Low-priority follow-up in t-4cb0.
